 Imagine running an entire AI-driven trading firm right on your laptop. Trading Agents is an open-source Python framework with over 100,000 stars on GitHub that simulates a real financial trading floor. Instead of relying on a single prompt, it deploys a team of specialized AI agents. You get fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysts passing research to bullish and bearish agents who debate the trade. Finally, a trader agent proposes execution while risk and portfolio managers approve the final order. You can connect local models via Olamma or Enterprise APIS like OpenAI and Anthropic. Run back tests and evaluate portfolio decisions over time on GitHub.
